subject: ela
skillName: Determine two or more main ideas
intro: Longer informational texts can have two or more main ideas, each supported by key details. Fifth graders find the main ideas and summarize the text, telling the most important points in their own words, without opinions. A summary is short and covers the key ideas.

items.prompt:
Read.

Exercise helps the body in two ways. It makes muscles stronger. It also keeps the heart healthy.

Name the TWO main ideas.

steps: I find the two big points.
One: exercise makes muscles stronger. Two: it keeps the heart healthy.
So the two main ideas are stronger muscles and a healthy heart.
solution.answer: Exercise strengthens muscles and keeps the heart healthy.

items.prompt:
Read (same text).

Write a short summary.

steps: A summary tells the key points briefly, no opinion.
So: 'Exercise helps the body by strengthening muscles and keeping the heart healthy.'
solution.answer: Exercise helps the body by strengthening muscles and keeping the heart healthy.

items.prompt: A summary should leave out your personal ____.

Read.

Recycling saves resources. It also reduces trash in landfills.

Two main ideas?

solution.answer: It saves resources and reduces landfill trash.

items.prompt: A short retelling of the key ideas is a ____.
Main ideas are supported by key ____.
